about: The one case table for FollowResolver (D117). Read by api/tests/FollowResolverTest.php (PHP resolver and the reminder job) and mobile/test/follow_resolver_test.dart (the app's copy), so the feed and the notifications must give the same answer. Columns: rsvp (null = no answer), mode (null = a run with no series), usuallyComes, then the expected followed and inMine. Rule numbers are the My runs order in the build plan: 1 RSVP, 2 hide, 3 follow, 4 auto.
